name: Weaver's Strawberries Hopecrest Farm
description: In Blackville, SC, Weaver's Strawberries Hopecrest Farm raises Strawberries on a working farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
